final: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), total AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_count FROM region_counts), shares AS (SELECT r.region, r.client_count, 1.0 * r.client_count / t.total_count AS share FROM region_counts AS r JOIN total AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.client_count), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.share - m.value) FROM shares AS s JOIN mean_share AS m ON m.value IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > m.value
